outcome: Number of patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) development
finding: Supplemental iron intake (SII) in early singleton pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of developing GDM and may improve Hb and ferritin levels, and infant birthweight.
mod_finding: Women in the intervention group (SII) had a greater likelihood of vaginal delivery and cesarean section.
birth_weight: Infants in the intervention group (SII) had significantly higher birthweight than those in the control group.
